about: Election day at the polls (owner, Oct 14, 2026: election day is a scene; the ballot is the scene's choice). Who may vote: a living resident of the town who is at least the voting age on election day, the rule the voting engine counts by (src/core2/modules/voting.ts holdElection). The voting age is the Twenty-Sixth Amendment's. Who goes along: the voter's household members who may vote too. Who works the polls: the poll workers the voting engine's polling-place record names for the voter's precinct (`pollingPlaceOf`), ranked there by duty, interest in politics and free hours.

votingAge.citation: U.S. Constitution, Twenty-Sixth Amendment (1971): the right to vote of citizens 18 years of age or older shall not be denied on account of age.
